Program Description

This International Year One course will help students develop their understanding of business concepts, encompassing key financial, marketing and management principles.

Pathway modules include: Financial Management; Introduction to People, Work and Organizations; Marketing Management; Quantitative Methods; Professional Practice for Business; and Economics for Business.

University of Greenwich International College is there to support students every step of the way in achieving academic success and offers Pre-Sessional English courses. If students do not meet the IELTS requirements for the program they wish to study, there are 6 or 12 week options available, which can be taken immediately before they enter their chosen pathway program.
6izk:
The International Year One - Business and Management course aims to develop and strengthen students' understanding of business and management and the application of business principles in a corporate environment. This course is equivalent to their first year of degree study and will strengthen their key business and management principles knowledge.

When students study business and management with the University of Greenwich, they will have the opportunity to pursue networking, mentoring and internship opportunities with global firms such as Apple, Barclays, Ford, Goldman Sachs, IBM, Microsoft, Northern Trust, Sony PlayStation, The Walt Disney Company, and Warner Music Group. They will benefit from the Business School Employability Team who will support them to develop their career skills and help them network with employers.

6izm:
The International Year One - Engineering course aims to broaden students' skillset and understanding of engineering, focusing on electronics, quality management principles, and process improvement.

At the postgraduate level, the pre-master’s provides either one term (10 weeks) or two terms (20 weeks) of preparation for entry into a 1-year master’s degree in engineering.

This Pre-Master's - Engineering course will help students build on their knowledge and develop new skills for the engineering industry related to electrical and electronic, mechanical and manufacturing, and management.

Engineering courses at the University of Greenwich are accredited by leading professional bodies. For example, the Master of Science (MSc) Electrical and Electronic Engineering is accredited by the Institution of Engineering and Technology as satisfying the further learning requirements for chartered engineer (CEng) registration. Individuals must hold a CEng-accredited honours degree as well as the accredited MSc for an exemption to CEng status.
6izg:
The International Year One programme provides an intensive combination of first-year university subject modules with extra study and English language skills.

The business and marketing degree will give students broad business skills, including project management and strategic thinking, plus a thorough grounding in marketing. This degree is designed to specialise in marketing to introduce students to business from an analytical, strategic and marketing point of view.

This course focuses on emerging issues such as sustainability, financial crises and technological innovation means that students will gain the skills to develop and manage businesses to a high standard. Through their studies, they will have the opportunity to work with business professionals and/or local communities on live projects.

Graduates of this course have gone into specialist strategic marketing areas such as retail management, consultancy, small to medium businesses and start-ups.

81e6:
The MBA Global with placement programme is designed to enable students to enhance their knowledge of global business. It provides a comprehensive understanding of global issues and supports students to become effective global leaders. Learning on the programme will rely mostly on real-world industry scenarios. This will ensure that participants are equipped with the necessary skills and theoretical knowledge required to address contemporary business-related issues. The programme will explore a wide range of subject areas including:

  • dynamics of global business and practice
  • global entrepreneurship and innovation
  • ethics and global corporate citizenship
  • leading and managing change
  • international data analytics
  • financial resource management
  • simulated learning projects
  • business consultancy projects
  • global supply chains
  • strategic management and leadership
  • marketing and sales in the future economy
  • work-based project

After the first year of study, students on the programme will embark on a mandatory one-year industry placement with any organisation of their choice. The placement year will provide students with the opportunity to apply the knowledge gained in their first year of study in a practical context. Students will be able to establish the link between academic theories and professional practice and in the process sharpen their skills. Student can find out more about placements here.

The MBA Global with placement programme responds to the needs and expectations of employers by equipping students with the hard and soft skills required to thrive and take up higher management positions as global business leaders.
7kzx:
Studying a Master’s in Business at the University of Greenwich will give students a grounding in business management and insight into business network analysis. Students are taught by an exceptional teaching team that includes accomplished lecturers and practitioners with vast experience in business network analysis, business management and strategy.

The MBA Global with placement is created to help students enhance their intellectual and professional abilities as excellent leaders and managers globally.

Two terms:

The duration of this programme is 24 months, including 12 months of certified work experience after the completion of taught courses but in conjunction with independent research. The responsibility for finding suitable certified work experience is the students. If no appropriate certified work experience is available after completing the taught courses and dissertation, the student will graduate with a MA in International Business.
